MILESTONE
SHIPPED: Hide Dock Icon toggle in Settings > General > System Integration (commit 5410774)
COMPONENTS:
- `SystemBehaviorSettings.hide_dock_icon: bool` (default false, not synced)
- `src-tauri/src/platform/macos.rs`: `set_dock_icon_visible()` via direct Cocoa FFI
- Applied at startup and on runtime toggle (no restart needed)
- After hide: re-focuses window only if it was already visible (prevents focus steal)
- Overlay manager respects hide_dock_icon when restoring policy post-overlay
- Frontend: `hideDockIcon` added to both `loadSettings` and `preparedSettings` mappings
SIGNIFICANCE: User feedback — Dock icon was 'super annoying' for a hotkey-driven utility app
ENABLES: App can now run as a pure menu-bar / tray utility
